name: Launch Spotlight
tagline: Launch-video-kit film: warm light ground, hero words punching in on their spoken word, soft glass clicks.

motion.direction: A launch film. Hero words (1–4 words, mixed case, weight 800, 110–150 px) punch in from oversize and land on their spoken word; one key word per statement in `ter`. Name → claim → product shots landing on the words that name them (straight `imageCard`s or `splitCards`, tilt 0–1) → feature blocks (`chips`, one per feature, landing word by word) → `lockCard` tease and `reveal` for the price or date → quiet lockup. A beat every 1.2–1.8 s in kinetic stretches, hero holds at least 0.6 s, payoffs at least 1 s. Accent on exactly one element per shot. No whooshes-y stamps, no patterns, no slams at weight 900, no slow title cards, no film strips.
